subject: Request: DPIA evidence & audit access for AlturaBank pilot
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@alturabank.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@alturabank.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AlturaBank pilot: DPIA support & evidence request

Hi Ben / Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for the productive kickoff yesterday. As part of our internal risk gating for the pilot, our DPO has asked for some supporting materials so we can complete a DPIA and confirm audit access. Attached is our DPIA questionnaire (Excel) with a few targeted tabs on subprocessors, data flows, and export controls.

Can you provide the following by EOD next Wednesday (2027-04-14)?
- Confirmed list of subprocessors and effective dates of onboarding.
- Redacted sample of the Art. 30 processing activities ledger (exportable CSV or PDF).
- Outline of the audit access model (remote evidence, live walkthrough, on-site), and any constraints for AlturaBank auditors.

We may request an on-site visit, but would prefer remote evidence where possible. Procurement copied here for scheduling and PO next steps.

Attachments: AlturaBank_DPIA_Questions_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Sara Kim
Project Manager, Transformation
AlturaBank

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@alturabank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AlturaBank pilot: DPIA support & evidence request

Sara — thanks for sending this over. We can support the DPIA and provide the artifacts you requested. Initial answers below and next steps at the end.

Quick answers:
- Subprocessors: we will provide a current inventory and onboarding dates (CSV). We use a staged onboarding process; for pilot workloads we can restrict to a fixed subprocessor allowlist.
- Art. 30 ledger: we can export a redacted ledger showing processing purpose, categories, recipients and international transfers.
- Audit access: Redwood supports remote evidence (logs, ledger export, configuration snapshots) and a guided remote walkthrough. On-site audits are possible but require 30 days notice and a scoped statement of work (security + NDA).

I am attaching our DPA Annex that covers Art. 28/30 commitments and a draft audit-access SLA that spells out timelines and data handling during audits. We will not provide raw customer data during audits — we provide operational evidence (logs, config, process records) and can run agreed queries in our environment.

Requested clarifications from your DPIA:
1) Please confirm the data exporter scope (production traffic vs. aggregated telemetry).
2) If you require an unredacted Art. 30 ledger, we will need a legal basis and a scoped nondisclosure addendum.

Proposed next steps:
- I will upload the subprocessor CSV + redacted Art. 30 CSV by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa, can you pick a 60-minute window next week for a remote walkthrough (operations + logs)?
- Laura, legal will review the scope for any additional NDAs for ledger export.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Annex_ART28_30.pdf; audit-access-sla-draft.docx

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec (North America)
Redwood Inference

From: Data Protection Officer <dpo@alturabank.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@alturabank.com>, procurement@alturabank.com
Date: 2027-04-12T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AlturaBank pilot: DPIA support & evidence request

Ben / team,

Thanks for the quick reply and attachments. A few clarifying points from the DPO office:

- Subprocessors: we need both current and historical onboarding dates for the last 24 months (to understand when certain transfers began).
- Art. 30 ledger: the redacted export should retain the processing purpose, categories of data, retention periods, and recipients (anonymised if necessary).
- Audit model: remote evidence is preferred. If remote evidence is insufficient, we will consider on-site, but we need a guaranteed read-only mode and a clear list of what our auditors can inspect.

Two additional asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a description of your cross-border transfer mechanisms (SCCs, reliance on adequacy, or other safeguards) specifically for pilot workloads?
2) Please confirm retention of operational logs (WORM / immutable) and typical retention windows for debug vs. security logs.

We are targeting DPIA sign-off by 2027-04-30 to meet our internal pilot approval. If you can get the requested artifacts by 2027-04-14 as Sara proposed, that will keep us on track.

Regards,
AlturaBank DPO

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Data Protection Officer <dpo@alturabank.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@alturabank.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@alturabank.com
Date: 2027-04-13T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AlturaBank pilot: DPIA support & evidence request — proposed evidence plan

DPO / Sara / Ben —

Thanks for the clear asks. Operational plan below (we'll attach the exports once redaction is agreed):

1) Subprocessor inventory: CSV export with onboarding date + service scope. We will include historical entries back 24 months. (Attachment: subprocessors-24m.csv — to be uploaded)

2) Art. 30 ledger: We will produce a redacted CSV including: processing purpose, categories of data, retention period, recipients (pseudonymised), and transfer mechanism. If AlturaBank requires unmasked recipients, please have legal share a scoped NDA.

3) Cross-border transfers: Redwood supports SCCs for pilot workloads; where SCCs are not in play we rely on adequacy decisions per region. Full transfer mapping doc will be shared.

4) Logs & retention: Security logs (WORM) are retained 12 months immutable; debug/operational traces 30 days by default but we can configure extended retention for customer pilots. We'll export a sample immutable log digest for your review.

5) Audit model: propose
   - Week 1 (remote): delivery of artifacts + 60-min walkthrough (ops + security).
   - Week 2 (if needed): targeted live queries / additional screenshots.
   - On-site: available with 30 days notice and a scoped SOW.

Proposed remote walkthrough slots (all PDT): 2027-04-19 09:00-10:00, 2027-04-20 13:00-14:00, 2027-04-21 15:00-16:00. Ben, can you confirm which works with AlturaBank?

Next actions for Redwood: finalise redacted Art. 30 export and subprocessors CSV and upload to the secure share. Laura / Rishi — please confirm any legal caveats for ledger exports; we should avoid raw user data being moved off-platform.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
